svg.title: From the first instruction to QEMU's exit, one step at a time

g.title: QEMU's own reset code, 6 instructions at 0x1000, jumps to 0x80000000: _start's first instruction, the first of the program. No register the program uses has been set yet.
g.text: before this: QEMU's reset code at 0x1000 (6 instructions, not shown) jumped here

g.title: auipc: sp is this instruction's address plus 0x10 << 12, 0x80010000.
addi: sp goes up by 64 to 0x80010040, stack_top, the top of the stack. The two make start.S's la sp, stack_top.
jal, which call main became: ra keeps the return address, 0x8000000c, and pc goes to main at 0x80000038.
li a0, 42: the compiler's one line of work. main's result is in a0.
ret: pc goes back to ra, 0x8000000c, the instruction after the call.
andi a0, a0, 0xff, shown as zext.b: only the low 8 bits of main's result count. 42 stays 42.
lui: t0 = 0x5000, the upper bits of a constant.
addiw: t0 = 0x5555. With the lui before it, this is li t0, 0x5555.
beqz: a0 is not 0, so no jump: the status is not 0, and start.S builds a word that says so.
slli: a0 shifted 16 bits left, 0x2a0000: the status moves to the word's upper half.
lui: t1 = 0x3000, the upper bits of a constant.
addiw: t1 = 0x3333. With the lui before it, this is li t1, 0x3333.
or: t0 = a0 | t1 = 0x2a3333, the status over 0x3333.
lui: t1 = 0x100000, the test device's address (li t1, 0x100000 is this one instruction).
sw: the word 0x2a3333 is stored at 0x100000, the test device. QEMU reads it: 0x3333 in the low half says stop, failing, and the upper half, 0x2a, is the code to exit with.
QEMU has exited with code 42: the shell's $? is 42. The loop at the end of _start never runs.
